messages.subject: Using xyplot with Knitr (TexStudio), panels were created but no data points (when compiling using RStudio, everything is fine)
messages.subject_clean: Using xyplot with Knitr (TexStudio), panels were created but no data points (when compiling using RStudio, everything is fine)
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I am pretty new to Knitr, and currently using TexStudio with knitr.

I found a weird problem: when I am trying to use xyplot, knitr can generate all the panels but the panels are empty. For example:

<<p2-1>>=
require(faraway)
require(nlme)
data("attenu")
head(attenu)
require(lattice)
xyplot(log(accel) ~ log(dist) | event, data = attenu, layout = c(6,4))
@

Then I get:

However, it should be (and can be generated in RStudio using Knitr, exact same codes):

Can anyone help me and explain why I got different plots in RStudio and TexStudio?

Thanks,

Yi

messages.subject: Re: [knitr] How to deal with multiple .tex files?
messages.subject_clean: [knitr] How to deal with multiple .tex files?
messages.body_plain:
Knitr does not use YAML... that is an rmarkdown feature. If you are modifying existing TeX files perhaps you just want to put the code in Rnw files that don't involve any kind of markdown or YAML? Or perhaps you just need to give us a minimum  (non-)working example?

https://yihui.name/knitr/demo/child/
